visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with styled dark hair, wearing a black t-shirt and a bracelet, stands outdoors in front of a modern storefront with a large sign reading 'DRX 達特仕'. He gestures energetically toward the camera. Bright natural daylight illuminates the scene. (2) A close-up shot features a white and gold cosmetic jar held by a hand; the jar has 'DRX' branding. The background is a clean, white indoor surface. (3) The man returns to the outdoor setting, gesturing near his face. An animated icon of a smooth white egg with sparkle effects appears as a graphic overlay next to his head. (4) The scene shifts to a bright, high-end retail interior with sleek display shelves and screens. The man stands behind a white counter, presenting the skincare jar. (5) A woman with short hair and glasses, wearing a tan blazer over a white top, joins the man. They stand side-by-side in the store, smiling and interacting through hand gestures. (6) A series of close-up shots demonstrate products: a white tube of cleanser and white cotton pads. A hand is seen lathering a white foaming cleanser under a running faucet. (7) Close-up on the back of a hand where a white cream is being massaged into the skin, showing its texture. (8) The man and woman continue their conversation in the studio-like store environment, holding the products and pointing to various features. (9) The man concludes by holding all three products—a jar and a tube—smiling and nodding toward the camera in a medium close-up shot.

A male voice speaks with high energy and rapid delivery, using exaggerated pitch contours to express excitement. (2) A sharp 'Ding' SFX punctuates the mention of a specific product. (3) A female voice enters, maintaining a professional yet friendly and cheerful tone. The interaction includes overlapping laughter and rapid-fire dialogue. (4) Cartoon-style 'boing' and 'bubble' SFX are triggered during humorous facial expressions or transitions between product shots. (5) Subtle liquid splashing sounds are heard during a cleanser demonstration, mixed beneath the dominant narration. (6) The BGM remains constant throughout as an energetic bed, ending with a final bright synthesizer flourish synchronized with the man's closing statement.
